reason: Provides a web interface status indicator that monitors the local dsh service through a process-local HTTP heartbeat and periodic browser polling.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中显示本地服务的在线或离线状态，并定期通过进程内 HTTP 心跳进行检测。
summaries.en: Displays the local DeepSeek Harness service as online or offline in the web interface using periodic process-local HTTP heartbeat checks.

capabilities: Registers a process-local HTTP ping endpoint
Displays online and offline status in the web interface
Polls the local endpoint every 15 seconds
